title: Pancho's Permutation
statement: The task is to find the k-th lexicographically smallest permutation of length n (n up to 10^6, k up to 10^18) consistent with partially erased entries, where no proper prefix or suffix is itself a permutation (sum- and skew-indecomposable). Equivalently every length-s prefix has maximum above s and minimum at most n-s; since 20! exceeds 10^18, early gaps are filled greedily and only the last ~20 are counted by DP.
